en: I was watching a YouTube video
where someone explaining human uniqueness
came on and said:
"Don't live chasing other people.

text:
당신 스스로 이미 고유합니다
당신 자신을 *찾으세요*"
en: You're already unique. Find yourself."
That's what they say. Find it how?
How? I don't even know who I am.
How am I supposed to find it?
He makes money off it, so he's found his uniqueness,
but I don't know what to do with my life.
So how am I supposed to find my uniqueness?
Literally, "I belong to myself."

text:
이런 자율적 개인의 *자유*는
큰 대가가 따르죠
en: That kind of freedom comes at a high price.
Because it's all on you,

text:
무한 경쟁 속에서
끝없이 자기 계발의 *긍정형*과
en: endless competition splits us into the self-improvers

text:
이길 수 없다는 생각으로
도태되는 *포기형*으로 나누죠
en: and the ones who give up, sure they can't win.

text:
내가 내 인생을
행복하게 있다고 생각하니까
en: I think I can make my own life happy,

text:
*책임*이 나한테 있으니까
끝없이 자기 계발을 하죠
en: it's all on me, so I keep improving myself.
The self-improver keeps at it, and then
what happens in the end? You give up.
"I just can't do it."
You try, it doesn't work, so you play games,
then you watch movies.

text:
그렇지 않고는
어떻게 살아갈 수 있어요
en: How else could you live
with yourself?

text:
시장은 우리의 이런 추구를
기꺼이 도와주며
en: The market is glad to help
and sells our exhaustion and emptiness back to us.
We're easy prey.
